 sec=[{'name':strings[x[0]:].split(b'\0',1)[0].decode(),'flags':x[2],'offset':x[4],'bytes':x[5]} for x in sections]

 return sec,[{'type':x[0],'flags':x[1],'offset':x[2],'bytes':x[5]} for x in segments]

"""Read-only strict rollback proof: only nvcc's non-loadable temporary filename may differ."""
from pathlib import Path
import struct,re,json,hashlib
OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;ROOT=OUT.parents[4]
parent=OUT/'gem16-run-parent';current=ROOT/'build/Linux/blackwell-release/bin/gem16-run'
a=parent.read_bytes();b=current.read_bytes();assert len(a)==len(b)
def structure(data):
 assert data[:6]==b'\x7fELF\x02\x01'
 phoff,shoff=struct.unpack_from('<QQ',data,32);phentsize,phnum,shentsize,shnum,shstrndx=struct.unpack_from('<HHHHH',data,54)
 sections=[struct.unpack_from('<IIQQQQIIQQ',data,shoff+i*shentsize) for i in range(shnum)]
 ss=sections[shstrndx];strings=data[ss[4]:ss[4]+ss[5]]
 sec=[{'name':strings[x[0]:].split(b'\0',1)[0].decode(),'flags':x[2],'offset':x[4],'bytes':x[5]} for x in sections]
 segments=[struct.unpack_from('<IIQQQQQQ',data,phoff+i*phentsize) for i in range(phnum)]
 return sec,[{'type':x[0],'flags':x[1],'offset':x[2],'bytes':x[5]} for x in segments]
sa,pa=structure(a);sb,pb=structure(b);assert sa==sb and pa==pb
differences=[i for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a,b)) if x!=y]
assert len(differences)<=8 and differences
for offset in differences:
 enclosing=[s for s in sa if s['offset']<=offset<s['offset']+s['bytes']];assert len(enclosing)==1 and enclosing[0]['name']=='.strtab' and not (enclosing[0]['flags']&2)
 assert not any(p['type']==1 and p['offset']<=offset<p['offset']+p['bytes'] for p in pa)
for s in sa:
 if s['name']!='.strtab':assert a[s['offset']:s['offset']+s['bytes']]==b[s['offset']:s['offset']+s['bytes']],s['name']
loads=[]
for p in pa:
 if p['type']==1:
  x=a[p['offset']:p['offset']+p['bytes']];y=b[p['offset']:p['offset']+p['bytes']];assert x==y
  loads.append({**p,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(x).hexdigest()})
pattern=rb'tmpxft_[0-9a-f]{8}_00000000-6_sm120\.cudafe1\.cpp'
left=a.rfind(b'\0',0,min(differences))+1;right=a.find(b'\0',max(differences));assert 0<=left<right
name_a=a[left:right];name_b=b[left:right]
assert re.fullmatch(pattern,name_a) and re.fullmatch(pattern,name_b)
assert a.count(name_a)==b.count(name_b)==1
assert a[:left]+bytes(right-left)+a[right:]==b[:left]+bytes(right-left)+b[right:]
xa=[name_a];yb=[name_b]

result={'read_only':True,'binary_modified':False,'parent_path':str(parent),'current_path':str(current),'parent_sha256':hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest(),'current_sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'file_bytes':len(a),'differing_offsets':differences,'only_difference_section':'.strtab (non-SHF_ALLOC, outside every PT_LOAD)','parent_temporary_name':xa[0].decode(),'current_temporary_name':yb[0].decode(),'all_load_segments_byte_identical':True,'all_other_sections_byte_identical':True,'identical_load_segments':loads,'proof':'whole files match after replacing only one exact nvcc PID temporary-name string; no binary is edited. CPU code/data, CUDA PTX/SASS/fatbins and all loaded metadata are byte identical.'}
p=OUT/'rollback/elf-equivalence.json';assert not p.exists();p.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
